assertions.subject: Patent Foramen Ovale
assertions.quote: The foramen ovale only completely closes as expected in about 75% of adults.

assertions.subject: Patent Foramen Ovale
assertions.predicate: left atrial pressure higher than right atrial pressure
assertions.quote: Fortunately, the left atrial pressure is usually higher than the right atrial pressure

assertions.subject: Patent Foramen Ovale
assertions.quote: a small amount of deoxygenated blood from the right atrium may be allowed to enter the left atrium

assertions.subject: Patent Foramen Ovale
assertions.quote: A complication of patent foramen ovale (PFO) that may be of clinical concern is a paradoxical embolus

assertions.subject: Patent Foramen Ovale
assertions.quote: The risk is predictably related to the size of the PFO

assertions.subject: Atrial Septal Defect
assertions.quote: Note that this is quite different than an atrial septal defect, in which a pathological opening exists between the left and right atria
